answer: Running a farm therefore means funding every sock puppet through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. Because the age is read from the plume checkpoint rather than self-declared, the copper audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. An identity must be at least 7 epochs old on the delta ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
